sessions.searchPlaceholder: Search session ID, sender, or message

config.title: Config
config.description: Schema-driven editor with defaults, search, and config file management.
config.mergedJsonDescription: Direct editor for the merged runtime config payload.
config.searchPlaceholder: Search by field name or description
config.saveHint: Save writes only changed keys back to the config API.
config.saveRestartRequired: Saved. Some settings require a restart to take effect.
config.advancedHint: Raw TOML files, for what the management pages do not cover. Providers, credentials, models, defaults and routes have their own pages, which plan and validate every change. A file that holds a secret is shown redacted and is read-only here; set its keys on the Providers page.
config.readOnlyRedacted: This file holds a secret: it is shown redacted and is read-only here. Set credentials on the Providers page.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.timeoutInvalid: Timeout must be at least 1000 ms.

skills.title: Skills
skills.confirmUninstall: Are you sure you want to uninstall "{name}"?

login.title: PRX Console Login
login.hint: Enter your gateway auth token to continue.

manage.unverified: Not verified by the model evidence:
manage.maskedValue: A value in this change is masked (it contains [redacted], [REDACTED] or ***). A masked value is never sent: type the full value, or leave the field empty to keep what is stored.
manage.maskedPrefill: A masked value (a URL with credentials or a secret) was not copied into the form. Type the full value to change it; fields left empty keep what is stored.

providers.title: Providers
providers.rootKey: Root API key (sent to the default provider)
providers.rootKeyStored: The key was stored. It is never shown again.
providers.referenceHint: A credential reference stores a value that is not shown again. A model route, embedding route, or agent of this provider can use it when its configuration names the reference. Default Gateway and channel turns use the root connection.
providers.referenceStored: The credential reference was stored. It is never shown again.
providers.liveConfirm: A live test sends one model-list request to the provider with its stored credential. Continue?
providers.endpointMasked: Current endpoint: {endpoint}. It is masked, so it is not prefilled; type the full URL to change it.
providers.maskedProvider: This provider's name contains credentials and is shown masked. Manage it with the prx CLI.

models.title: Models
models.declarationHint: A declaration states what a model (or every model of a provider) can do. Unset fields declare nothing; negative catalog evidence still wins.
models.everyModel: Empty: every model of the provider

routing.title: Defaults, routes and agents
routing.rootCredentialAsk: Refuse if the root key would move
routing.rootCredentialKeep: Keep it for the new provider

changes.title: Configuration changes
changes.intro: Every change made through the CLI, the Gateway or the Console is recorded here with its redacted plan. A rollback restores the configuration from before a record as a new change.
changes.requiredRestoreCredentials: This rollback restores a credential the current configuration no longer holds. Confirm to restore it.
changes.requiredDisableEncryption: This rollback turns secrets encryption off. Confirm to allow it.

decisionApproval.refreshFailed: The execution response was received, but the conversation could not be refreshed. Refresh the conversation to inspect it; do not repeat the operation.
decisionApproval.singleUse: This saved operation can be executed once.
decisionApproval.title: Review a pending operation
decisionApproval.redacted: Some arguments are hidden. Resume uses the original saved call.
decisionApproval.noSnapshot: This older record has no saved call. Resume requires the original arguments through the API.
decisionApproval.separate: Approval and execution are separate actions. The server rechecks current permission and expiration before execution.
decisionApproval.approved: Approval recorded. The operation has not run.
decisionApproval.notCompleted: The operation did not report successful completion. Check the conversation before taking further action.
decisionApproval.uncertain: The execution result is unknown. Check the conversation before reloading; do not assume the operation failed.

decisionInspect.title: Decision inspection
decisionInspect.scope: Only decisions visible to your authenticated account are listed.
decisionInspect.invalidWindow: The start must be before the end.
decisionInspect.limit: At most 100 decisions, newest first. Narrow the time window for older records.
decisionInspect.legacy: Legacy record: current decision guarantees do not apply.
decisionInspect.noOutcome: No outcome is recorded. This does not establish success or failure.
decisionInspect.childrenNote: Delegated means dispatch completed. Child completion is recorded separately.
decisionInspect.noChildren: No child outcomes are linked. Child completion is unknown.
decisionInspect.childrenTruncated: Only the first 64 linked child outcomes are shown.
decisionInspect.probabilityNote: These are recorded predictions, not evidence that an action ran or a causal claim. Missing and legacy distributions remain unavailable.
decisionInspect.projectionNote: This is the projection saved at decision time, not a reconstruction from current input.
decisionInspect.projectionRedacted: Current display redaction additionally masked parts of this saved projection.
decisionInspect.noProjection: No displayable projection was recorded or it is unavailable.

decisionPlane.title: Decision plane
decisionPlane.previewOnly: Forms propose changes, not current configuration values. Review the diff before applying. Blank policy fields leave those settings unchanged.
decisionPlane.remoteNote: Remote access can send decision data outside this machine. Review the plan and its risk confirmation before applying.
decisionPlane.referenceOnly: Enter an existing cred- reference or none to clear. Never enter a secret in this field.
decisionPlane.invalidTimeout: Timeout must be an integer of at least 10 ms; the server also enforces the decision budget.

decisionTest.answered: Primitives answered by the serving backend
decisionTest.title: Backend test
decisionTest.localNote: Local tests use only builtin or loopback backends. A remote configuration can report requires_live without sending a request.
decisionTest.liveNote: A live test sends one neutral decision request to the configured backend and may be billed. This does not enable remote access permanently.
decisionTest.interpretation: passed, fell_back and not_tested are different outcomes. A fallback does not prove that the requested backend works.
decisionTest.failed: The test failed or its result is unknown. No automatic retry was made; a request may already have been sent.

decisionCredential.refreshFailed: The credential write was confirmed, but status could not be refreshed. Refresh status before making another change.
decisionCredential.previousLeft: The new credential was stored and selected, but the previous credential could not be removed. Review credential maintenance before considering rotation complete.
decisionCredential.title: Replace decision credential
decisionCredential.note: This stores a new credential for the configured decision backend and updates its reference. The existing secret is never loaded. The server may refuse permission or a changed configuration.
decisionCredential.prepareFailed: Could not read the configuration revision. No secret was sent.
decisionCredential.failed: The write failed or its result is unknown. The input was cleared and no automatic retry was made. Inspect configuration before trying again.

decisionReport.title: Evaluation report
decisionReport.meaning: Prediction agreement with observed successful paths is not causal proof. Missing metrics remain unavailable.
decisionReport.readOnly: This report is computed without saving a calibration file.
decisionReport.savedNote: Use a report already saved by prx causal evaluate. Reading a report above does not save it. The server validates the report and current backend before producing a reviewable plan.

reportCatalog.scope: Only reports with verified ownership are listed. Historical unbound reports and local-operator reports are excluded.
reportCatalog.partial: The catalog is incomplete or unavailable. This selection may omit newer reports.
reportCatalog.empty: No verified reports in this result.
